name: metacooler-viewer
description: Browser-based viewer for .metacool multi-genome Hi-C contact maps. No backend, no preprocessing.

comments.test:nofixtures: Everything that does not need test/fixtures/, which are generated by `npm run fixtures` and need a Python interpreter with metacooler installed. This is what a fresh clone and a CI runner without metacooler can verify; `npm test` is the full suite and is what to run before a release.
comments.overrides: This host runs glibc 2.28 (RHEL 8); rollup's native binding requires GLIBC_2.29 and fails to dlopen. @rollup/wasm-node is rollup's own drop-in for unsupported platforms. Slower to build, identical output. Remove this override on a host with glibc >= 2.29.
